protocol.frozen_at: 2026-10-28, before any v2 acceptance step; v1 (run capacity-repeats-20261028T080352534437Z) gated stage D on producer records and treated a missing processing age as 0 - superseded
protocol.profile: paced real-time demo profile (PRD 18.3): producer paced to the source timeline with a 200 ms lead; the backend releases each frame at its source time
protocol.ladder_stop_rule: stop increasing at the first step that fails any gate, trips the resource guard, or lacks memory headroom

gates.cadence_basis: 90% of the configured analytics target 8 fps/camera (configs/cameras.yaml analytics_fps). Stage D: frames the backend analytics consumed (release log, analytics_done) per camera; stages A-C: frames the producer emitted. The 29.97 fps source rate is reported separately.
gates.receive_to_result_basis: stage D only: backend analytics_done minus backend stdout read time, same host clock, over every produced frame in the window; a produced frame never consumed is a missing delivery (fail), never excluded
gates.producer_schedule_lag_basis: stages A-C (no consumer): producer emit time minus the frame's due time on the source timeline anchored at the feed's first frame; negative = the deliberate 200 ms lead. A real-time keep-up criterion, NOT receive-to-result latency
gates.backlog_basis: last-minute median minus first-minute median of the gated latency (D: receive-to-result; A-C: producer schedule lag); D also reports backend queue depth
gates.missing_measurement: any required metric that is unavailable fails the step explicitly
gates.expected_feed_set: every configured feed must be measured; an absent feed fails the step
gates.memory_growth_basis: last-minute median minus first-minute median of the measured window
gates.cleanup: every owned container confirmed absent after the step

resource_policy.preflight_basis: measured 2026-10-28 (reports/benchmarks/memory-diagnosis-20261028T114500000000Z): 4 stage-C containers took ~2.6 GiB of host memory
resource_policy.between_steps: WSL route: guest clean page cache dropped after cleanup and before preflight/warm-up (never inside a measured window); result recorded per step
resource_policy.on_trip: stop owned workloads, write INTERRUPTED.json, exit 2 and start no further step (ladder: the step is the first unacceptable one)

time_bases.clock_offset: WSL/container minus host, best of 9 round trips, measured before and after every step; uncertainty = half the best round trip. Used only for the reported producer->backend transit.
time_bases.capture_to_result: not measured: file replay has no capture clock

reported_not_gated: fraction of the 29.97 fps source rate
host CPU/RAM and WSL guest memory
